title: SpeakerSegment
description: One speaker turn within a normalized transcript. Source of truth: design-doc §9.

speaker_id.description: Diarization-assigned id (e.g. speaker_1) or 'unknown' for transcript-only inputs without speaker info.

start_ms.description: Null when source has no timestamps (e.g. pasted_transcript without timing).

is_final.description: False for interim live STT output; true for finalized turns and any imported segment.
